claim_ceiling: one-physical-target-set same-slide real-scanner device-RGB nuisance and bounded canonicalizer research evidence only

evidence_contract.rights_scope: internal research and testing only; no redistribution or commercial training

candidate_contract.legacy_affine_fit: reuse SF2.7A coefficient and bias bounds but evaluate before clipping
candidate_contract.safe_matrix_fit: nonnegative least squares per output row followed by row-sum projection to at most one

branch_rule.pass: retain the bounded matrix as a one-target-set scanner-nuisance canonicalizer research control and open held-target replication
branch_rule.fail_relative: retain SF2.7A as nuisance-magnitude evidence and close this safe RGB canonicalizer
branch_rule.fail_absolute_or_pair: retain the spectral P6D reference and classify real-scanner RGB canonicalization as support-limited

forbidden_claims: scanner spectral calibration or device-independent colourimetry
Velvia stock response or digital-to-film operator
independent roll, target manufacture, process or scanner population generalization
latent film mode, stock identity or authenticity
training, product integration, redistribution or commercial use
